args.subject: Request for Free Consultation
args.body:
Hello,

I recently received your email about your event organization services, and I would like to take you up on the offer of a free consultation.

Please let me know what times work for you and how I can get in touch to schedule the consultation.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
